building: Maurice G. Knoy Hall of Technology
reviewer: independent audit agent; did not build or edit Knoy R19

criteria.name: Identity and footprint
evidence: Purdue GIS footprint and campus context support identity and general stepped form.
R19 supplies a candidate facade edge sightline.
findings: Project local conversion is approximate, not survey control.

criteria.name: Placement, orientation, and scale
evidence: Prior manifest and placement evidence remains applicable; R19 changed no placement or transform.
findings: No new survey control or independent orientation/scale measurement was added.

criteria.name: Height, floors, and roof
evidence: Indiana 2018 DSM provides a broad roof-like surface distribution.
findings: DSM does not establish roof slab/parapet height, occupied L5, or penthouse geometry; GIS 48-ft conflict remains.
No vertical geometry changed in R19.

criteria.name: Exterior and entrances
evidence: Purdue Archives photo supports brick-heavy massing and interrupted horizontal glazing on photographed faces.
findings: Model still repeats broad continuous glazing ribbons across elevations.
R19 does not alter visible facade fidelity; source photo is not georeferenced to a specific model face.

criteria.name: Interior and circulation
evidence: Saved model includes plan traces, illustrative doors, fixtures, and stairs.
findings: Geometry is not verified against a digitized as-built circulation/stair plan.

criteria.name: Technical and evidence quality
evidence: Blender 5.2.3 reopen succeeded; four facade mesh fingerprints match R18; no unpacked images.
findings: R19 JSON and SVG give different camera XY and ray intersection for the same pano: JSON camera [260.38,78.59] / hit [234.472,66.136] / u=.69; SVG camera [261.607,77.251] / hit [235.921,64.898] / u≈.91.
The diagram should be regenerated or reconciled before using it for face-specific edits.

sightline_discrepancy.assessment: Both plotted ray pairs are individually plausible for the stated heading, but they do not use the same camera coordinates or edge intersection. The discrepancy is unresolved; no facade edit should rely on either until the source values are reconciled.

major_remaining_issues: Continuous glazing ribbons differ from interrupted slit-like glazing in the official photo on photographed faces.
No measured evidence resolves roof/L5/penthouse geometry or GIS 48-ft conflict.
No digitized as-built stair/circulation plan verifies full interior continuity.
R19 JSON and SVG sightline coordinates conflict by about 1.8-1.9 m.
